name: Huessen EPF1301
description: 13.3 inch E Ink Spectra 6 picture frame (EL133UF1 dual-controller glass) on an ESP32-S3 with octal PSRAM, battery and USB-C, sold as the Huessen EPF1301. Speaks Tesserae's v1 REST device API when flashed with the tesserae-device-firmware ESP-IDF build (boards/huessen_epf1301.h). Server-side pack via esp32_bin produces a 4-bpp Spectra 6 buffer (960000 bytes) that the firmware paints without any on-device quantise.
notes_md: Flash the tesserae-device-firmware `huessen-epf1301` build over the frame's USB-C port (USB-Serial-JTAG; back up the stock flash first, the install replaces the bootloader). Confirmed on real hardware running tesserae-device-firmware: palette correct, both controller halves in place, row 0 at the top of the portrait frame, and server frames painting end to end. Wire format is exactly 960000 bytes, the seeed_reterminal_e1004 format. Full refresh takes about 19 s. The battery must be fitted; the panel will not paint on USB power alone.
